summary: Outline is a collaborative wiki designed for team documentation and knowledge management. It provides a structured workspace where groups can author, organise, and share internal notes and guides.
goodFor: Teams looking for an extensible, self-hosted documentation hub to centralise their internal knowledge bases.
watchOut: It uses the Business Source License, which places specific restrictions on commercial use and competitive hosting until the code converts to an open source licence.
deployNotes: You will typically need to configure Docker containers alongside a persistent database and a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination for production use.
